q: How do I split energy into renewable and non-renewable in BRSR?
title: BRSR renewable vs non-renewable energy
short: In BRSR Principle 6, list electricity, fuel and other energy twice: once from renewable sources and once from non-renewable sources, all in gigajoules. Grid power, DG diesel, coal and gas are non-renewable. Self-consumed solar, contracted green power with supply proof and biomass are renewable. Convert kWh to GJ by multiplying by 0.0036.
audience: Listed companies and value chain suppliers filling BRSR Principle 6

ul: From renewable sources: total electricity consumption (A), total fuel consumption (B), energy from other sources (C), total (A+B+C).
From non-renewable sources: total electricity consumption (D), total fuel consumption (E), energy from other sources (F), total (D+E+F).
Total energy consumed, and energy intensity per rupee of turnover, per rupee adjusted for PPP, and per physical output if you choose.

sections.h: Which line each source goes in
ul: Grid electricity from the discom: D, non-renewable, even though the grid includes some renewable power.
Rooftop or captive solar used on site: A. Exported units under net metering are not consumption.
Green open access, group captive or a discom green tariff: A, only with supply evidence such as the open access schedule or the green tariff bill.
Diesel, petrol, coal, furnace oil, LPG, PNG: E.
Solar thermal water heating: C. Purchased steam from a fossil boiler: F.
Electricity: kWh x 0.0036 = GJ. 1,000,000 kWh = 3,600 GJ.
Diesel: about 0.0359 GJ per litre, from the IPCC 2006 NCV of 43.0 GJ per tonne and a density of about 0.835 kg per litre.
LPG: about 0.0473 GJ per kg, the IPCC 2006 NCV.
Coal: use the NCV from your lab report, because Indian coal varies widely by grade.
Renewable claims backed by documents, not by the generator's name.
No double counting of solar: generation used on site goes in A, and the grid units on the bill stay in D.
The same conversion factors in the current and previous year, with the basis disclosed.

example.title: Worked example: a mid sized plant's year
lines: Rooftop solar used on site: 200,000 kWh x 0.0036 = 720 GJ (A)
Non-renewable total: 3,600 + 718 = 4,318 GJ; renewable total: 720 GJ
example.note: The diesel conversion is an estimate from IPCC default NCV and a typical density; use your supplier's figures if available.
